criteria.text: Recipient has used a comparable dose of tizanidine tablets for at least 5 days without improvement in symptoms.
Recipient must not use tizanidine tablets concurrently with Zanaflex Capsules.

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid Zanaflex Capsules (tizanidine), capsules 2mg, 4mg and 6mg. Capsule product scope is implied by this pack; supporting tablet-trial documentation requires manual review.
Indication context (notes only): tizanidine is a short-acting drug for management of spasticity; reserve treatment for daily activities and times when relief of spasticity is most important.
No prior authorization is needed for tizanidine 2mg and 4mg tablets; this pack applies to capsules.
Denial: recipient has not used a comparable dose of tizanidine tablets for at least 5 days. The approval attestation also requires no improvement in symptoms.
Authorization (notes only): may be granted for up to 6 months.
Source: Version 1; Last updated 12/21/2010; Approved 1/21/2011. Parsed effective_date is null; existing 1970-01-01 metadata stub retained.
